flows.problem: Wi-Fi repeatedly disconnects

steps.instruction: Open Wi-Fi settings and confirm you are connected to the correct network
Turn Wi-Fi off and back on to force a fresh connection
Forget the network, then reconnect and re-enter the password
Turn off Airplane mode if it is enabled
Disable adaptive/smart network switching so the phone stops hopping to mobile data
If the problem continues, reset network settings

flows.problem: Connected to Wi-Fi but no internet access

steps.instruction: Open Wi-Fi settings and reconnect to the network
Toggle Airplane mode on and off to reset the radios
Restart your router and wait 30 seconds
Check that no VPN or private DNS is blocking traffic

flows.problem: Mobile data is not working

steps.instruction: Open data usage settings and confirm mobile data is switched on
Make sure Airplane mode is turned off
Check the preferred network mode and select automatic
Check whether Data Saver is restricting background data
Reseat the SIM card and restart the device

flows.problem: Mobile network intermittently switches between 5G and 4G without user action

steps.instruction: Open mobile network settings and check the preferred network type
Set the preferred network mode to 5G only or LTE/4G only to stop automatic switching
Toggle Airplane mode on for 10 seconds then off to re-register on the network
Reseat the SIM card and restart the device
Check with your carrier whether 5G coverage in your area is stable

flows.problem: Mobile hotspot will not turn on or other devices cannot connect

steps.instruction: Confirm mobile data is enabled — hotspot cannot share Wi-Fi by default
Open tethering settings and turn Mobile Hotspot on
Change the hotspot band to 2.4 GHz so older devices can see it
Reset the hotspot name and password, then reconnect the other device
Turn off Data Saver, which can block tethering

flows.problem: VoLTE calls fail or the device falls back to 3G for voice calls

steps.instruction: Open mobile network settings and ensure VoLTE or HD Calling is enabled
Check that the preferred network mode includes LTE or 5G
Toggle Airplane mode on and off to re-register on the network
Reseat the SIM card and restart the device
Contact your carrier to confirm VoLTE is provisioned on your account

flows.problem: VPN will not connect or keeps disconnecting

steps.instruction: Open VPN settings and verify the VPN configuration is correct
Disconnect and reconnect to the VPN
Switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data to rule out a network issue
Turn off battery optimization for the VPN app
Check that the date and time are set correctly — incorrect time breaks VPN certificates

flows.problem: Bluetooth earbuds or accessory will not connect

steps.instruction: Open Bluetooth settings and make sure Bluetooth is on
Put the earbuds in pairing mode and keep them within one metre
Unpair (forget) the device, then pair it again from scratch
Allow the Nearby devices permission if the companion app asks for it
Turn Location on — scanning for nearby devices can require it

flows.problem: Bluetooth audio stutters or cuts out

steps.instruction: Move the phone closer to the accessory and remove obstacles
Disconnect other paired Bluetooth devices
Turn Wi-Fi off briefly to check for 2.4 GHz interference
Clear the Bluetooth app cache in app settings

flows.problem: Bluetooth device connects but disconnects after a few seconds

steps.instruction: Unpair the Bluetooth device and pair it again
Turn off battery optimization for the Bluetooth-related app
Check that the Bluetooth device firmware is up to date
Disconnect all other paired devices to avoid connection conflicts
Restart both the phone and the Bluetooth device

flows.problem: SIM card is not detected by the device

steps.instruction: Remove the SIM card, clean the contacts gently, and reinsert it
Restart the device after reinserting the SIM
Open mobile network settings and check whether the SIM is recognized
Toggle Airplane mode on and off
Try the SIM card in another device to rule out a damaged SIM

flows.problem: eSIM activation or setup fails

steps.instruction: Ensure the device is connected to Wi-Fi before scanning the eSIM QR code
Open mobile network settings and select Add eSIM or Add mobile plan
Verify the QR code or activation details with your carrier
Check that the date and time are set automatically — incorrect time can block activation
Restart the device and try the activation again

flows.problem: NFC or contactless payments are not detected

steps.instruction: Open NFC settings and make sure NFC is turned on
Remove the phone case — thick cases can block the NFC antenna
Make sure the screen is unlocked when tapping — most payment apps require it
Set the correct default payment app in the Tap and pay settings
Restart the device and try again

flows.problem: Battery drains much faster than expected

steps.instruction: Open battery settings and review which apps used the most power
Enable Power saving mode
Restrict background activity for the heaviest apps
Lower screen brightness and shorten the screen timeout
Turn off Location for apps that do not need it
Turn off Wi-Fi and Bluetooth scanning when not in use

flows.problem: Phone charges slowly or not at all

steps.instruction: Inspect the charging port for lint and use the original cable and adapter
Check battery settings for fast charging options
Charge with the screen off and heavy apps closed
Restart the device and try a different power outlet

flows.problem: Screen is too dim, flickers or changes brightness by itself

steps.instruction: Open display settings and turn off adaptive brightness
Turn off Power saving mode, which caps brightness
Disable Blue light filter / Eye comfort shield
Restart in Safe mode to rule out a third-party app

flows.problem: Screen auto-rotation is not working or stuck in one orientation

steps.instruction: Swipe down the notification panel and make sure Auto-rotate is enabled
Open display settings and check for rotation or orientation options
Open accessibility settings and turn off any screen orientation lock
Restart the device to reset the sensor

flows.problem: No sound from speaker or during calls

steps.instruction: Open sound settings and raise media, ringtone and call volume
Turn off Do Not Disturb
Disconnect any Bluetooth device still receiving the audio
Clean the speaker grille and remove the case

flows.problem: Notifications are delayed or never arrive

steps.instruction: Open notification settings and allow notifications for the app
Turn off Do Not Disturb
Remove battery restrictions for the app so it can run in the background
Allow background data usage for the app

flows.problem: Camera is blurry, freezes or fails to open

steps.instruction: Wipe the lens and remove any case covering it
Force stop and clear the cache of the Camera app
Confirm the Camera permission is granted to the app you are using
Free up storage — the camera cannot save photos when full

flows.problem: Storage is full or the device warns about low space

steps.instruction: Open storage settings and review what is using space
Clear cached data for the largest apps
Delete or back up large videos and downloads
Uninstall apps you no longer use

flows.problem: An app keeps crashing, freezing or closing by itself

steps.instruction: Force stop the app, then clear its cache
Update the app from the store
Check the app's permissions are granted
Free storage space and restart the device

flows.problem: GPS or location is inaccurate or unavailable

steps.instruction: Open location settings and turn Location on
Enable improved accuracy using Wi-Fi and Bluetooth scanning
Grant precise location permission to the app
Turn Wi-Fi on — it greatly improves positioning indoors

flows.problem: Device is slow, laggy or overheating

steps.instruction: Restart the device to clear background processes
Free up storage space
Review and restrict apps with high background battery use
Uninstall unused apps
Install the latest software update

flows.problem: Software update fails to download or install

steps.instruction: Connect to a stable Wi-Fi network before attempting the update
Free up at least 2 GB of storage for the update
Charge the device to at least 50% before retrying
Check the device info page for manual update options
Restart the device and try the update again

flows.problem: Account will not sign in or stops syncing

steps.instruction: Open account settings and check the account status
Turn sync off and on again for the affected account
Confirm the device has a working internet connection
Check that the date and time are set automatically
Remove the account and add it again

flows.problem: Fingerprint scanner does not recognize fingerprints or fails to unlock

steps.instruction: Clean the fingerprint sensor and your finger — moisture or dirt reduces accuracy
Open security settings and re-register your fingerprints
Register the same finger at different angles for better coverage
Remove any screen protector covering the in-display sensor
Increase the touch sensitivity setting if you use a screen protector
